objective: A first run stores a baseline and reports that nothing was compared
preconditions: a test with no stored baseline
input: Two consecutive runs of the same visual check against an unchanged page
expected: The first reports newBaseline, the second reports match — and the first is not reported as a pass, because "nothing to compare against" and "identical to the baseline" are different statements
detail: first newBaseline (1280x1694); second match at 0.0038% — the live timestamp's own noise, tolerated by the default threshold
